body: Replaced pickSubject's vacuum-based spontaneous subject discovery with discoverSubjectAnchoredToStyle: picks a style via the same weighted marble-bag scheme, asks Vertex for that style's archetypal subject (inverse of the existing subject->style discovery reasoning), retries with a different style if declined, until a subject is discovered or every style has been tried. Live-verified via direct call (bypassing the racy pity RNG gate): discovered 'Niobe' as a genuinely new subject. Commit emily.cli c8e995a.
title: Style-anchored subject discovery
